# Buildkite

Buildkite is a platform for running fast, secure, and scalable continuous integration pipelines on your own infrastructure.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/buildkite/.

## Actions

- **Get Current Access Token**: Retrieve the authenticated api access token details.
- **Get Meta**: Retrieve metadata about the buildkite api.
- **List Pipeline Agents**: List connected agents for an organization.
